sources.text: No source recorded for how it is made yet.

steps.note: Buffalo whey with a little whey starter from mozzarella is heated to about 90 °C, where its albumins flocculate.
The ricotta is taken off as it floats and filled into baskets without pressing.
It drains 4–5 hours at room temperature and then about 10 hours at 4 °C.

steps.name: bake
steps.note: It is baked about 12 hours in a wood-fired oven, unsalted, until it has the baked aroma and no rind.

links.name: Ricotta di bufala (salata, infornata, affumicata), PAT Lazio, in the Atlante dei prodotti tipici (ONAF)

sources.text: The steps and times of the Lazio buffalo-whey ricotta infornata from the regional list of traditional products; Wikipedia for the ricotta baked to a brown, lightly charred crust, with no oven temperature given by either.
